ratio_source.note: The public values come from catalog/search summaries, not a calibrated measurement of the photographed unit. reference_note: The six-view sheet is uncalibrated. Its right/left side panels show circular bearing-seat ends in a way that is inconsistent with the front and top panels' geometry; the rebuild follows the front/back/top/bottom structure and records the discrepancy. Cast lettering, the red grease fitting, hidden back faces and the underside pocket are inferred.
